svg.title: One agent found the answer. How do the others find out?
svg.desc: Three ways to connect six agents. Independent: agent 3's finding stays with it, agents 1 and 5 reach it on their own, and selection merges the answers. Through a coordinator: the finding goes to the coordinator, which forwards it to agents 1 and 5. Through shared memory: agent 3 writes the finding to a log, and agents 1 and 5 find it when they ask.
svg.text: AWESOME AGENT SWARMS · A SURVEY OF 153 WORKS ON LLM AGENT SWARMS
